rows.grounds: nominal subject naming the demonic host
fused negative pronoun and adjective expressing inequality
genitive plural describing warriors of noble birth

items.question: Do demons declare that flight in battle is unworthy of noble-born warriors?
items.inference: The verse presents demonic speech contrasting retreat with the honor expected of noble-born fighters.
uncertainties: whether naitatsamaṃ modifies flight or battle
items.plain_english: The demons say that such flight in battle is not fitting for those of noble birth.
